scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && npm run build:runtime
scripts.build:runtime: npm run check:runtime-config && npm run check:runtime-boundary && tsc --noEmit && vite build --config vite.runtime.config.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.runtime.json
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && npm run test:browser:smoke
scripts.test:browser:smoke: node scripts/browser-smoke.mjs && node scripts/surface-graph-browser-smoke.mjs && node scripts/renderer-fallback-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:visual: npm run build && node scripts/visual-suite.mjs && node scripts/terrain-game-context-visual.mjs
scripts.test:qa: npm run test:unit && npm run build && node scripts/capture-qa.mjs
scripts.qa:capture: npm run test:unit && npm run build && node scripts/capture-qa.mjs
scripts.ci: npm run check:version && npm run test:unit && npm run build && npm run test:browser:smoke && node scripts/build-runtime-package.mjs && node scripts/runtime-package-consumer-test.mjs
scripts.release:check: npm run ci && npm run terrain-presets:check && npm run test:bake-parity && npm run test:production-export && npm run test:cross-browser
